waybackify remaster [flags] [command]

Standalone-tier ops: build · verify

The remastered standalone tier — the served form that carries NONE of
archive.org and needs nothing off-host to render:

  build     remaster a hermetic cache root into a standalone tree
  verify    prove a remastered tree stands alone (static + dynamic)

Run `waybackify remaster <verb> --help` for a verb's full surface.

Flags:
  --help|-h   Show help

Commands:
  build       Remaster a hermetic cache root into a standalone root
  verify      Prove a remastered tree stands alone (no archive.org)

part of the wayback mirror tooling
